title: Dam flooded the Egyptian labyrinth in the 1960s

tellings.quote: What happened was they put up a dam and when they put up a dam to help the farmers out, they diverted the water and the water filled up this labyrinth.

plain: In the 1960s a dam built in Egypt to help farmers diverted water that filled an ancient underground complex called the Egyptian labyrinth, a vast building described long ago by the Greek historian Herodotus and the Roman writer Pliny the Elder. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan tells Michels this, passing on what he learned from a man named Ben van Kerkwijk: "they diverted the water and the water filled up this labyrinth." If so, one of the great lost wonders of the ancient world would be sitting underwater, out of reach.
